subject: mathematics
concept: Comparing theoretical probability to experimental probability from repeated trials
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Science and Engineering Practices (Analyzing and Interpreting Data) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student conducts repeated physical trials (coin flips, spins) and records experimental results against theoretical prediction
exercise.pictorial: Student graphs experimental results approaching the theoretical probability as trials increase
exercise.abstract: Student explains why experimental probability may differ from theoretical probability, especially with few trials

misconception_flags: expects experimental results to exactly match theoretical probability every single time regardless of trial count

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
